description: Write production-grade Playwright tests in TypeScript: Page Object Model, fixtures, auto-waiting, user-facing locators, parallel execution, CI integration, sharding, and 2025-2026 feature awareness. Includes an explicit "do not" list for AI agents. Use when: "Playwright," "write E2E test," "page object," "new Playwright suite," "Playwright config." Not for: fixing one flaky test at runtime — use test-reliability. Not for: bulk regenerating selectors after a UI refactor — use selector-drift-recovery. Not for: visual baseline creation/management — use visual-testing. Not for: deep WCAG/axe audits — use accessibility-testing. Related: visual-testing, ci-cd-integration, api-testing, test-reliability, selector-drift-recovery, accessibility-testing.
